policy: Samples from the masked softmax (as deployed), fresh LSTM state each game.
engine: coup/game.py, 1v1; seats alternate every game; seeded per game.
metric: winRate = Gen5 wins / games; ci95 is the 95% Wilson score interval; draws (500-turn cap) count as non-wins. avgTurns counts both players' turns.

opponents.label: Uniform random
opponents.description: RandomAgent: uniformly random legal actions; challenges 15%, blocks 25% of the time.

opponents.label: Random zoo profiles
opponents.description: ZooAgent.random_profile(): a fresh scripted personality each game (bluff, challenge, block and income rates drawn uniformly). 15% of Gen5's training games.

opponents.label: Rule-based heuristic
opponents.description: HeuristicAgent: never bluffs, always blocks when it holds the card, challenges with two copies. 10% of Gen5's training games.
